title: Nightruth: Explanation of the Paranormal: Making of Nightruth II: Voice Selection
native_title: メイキング・オブ・ナイトゥルースⅡ ～ボイス・セレクション～
overview:
The second private disc voice actor fans have been waiting for!

Even more upgraded than the previous release!

- See the surprising true faces of Yuko Miyamura and other popular voice actors in movies. It supports MPEG Sofdec, so you can enjoy video that is cleaner than ever!
- Introductions and previews of #01 "Yami no Tobira" and "Maria", narrated by Norio Wakamoto, delivered ahead of the main releases.
- And of course character introductions and a collection of original art are included too!

声優ファン待望のプライベートディスク第2弾！

前作よりさらにグレードアップ！

★宮村優子さん他の人気声優の意外な素顔がムービーで見れます。MPEG Sofdec対応なので今まで以上の超キレイな映像がウレシイ！
★♯01“闇の扉”と“Maria”の紹介と予告を、若本規夫さんのナレーションで本編より一足早くお届けします。
★もちろんキャラクター紹介や原画資料集もセット！
